cards.gloss_en: became less strong; died down
cards.ex_en: By morning the rain had abated.
cards.ex_cn: 到早晨雨已经减弱了。

cards.gloss_en: calm and in control of oneself
cards.ex_en: She stayed calm and composed during the test.
cards.ex_cn: 考试时她保持镇定冷静。

cards.gloss_en: again and again; without stopping
cards.ex_en: The baby cried continually all night.
cards.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜不停地哭。

cards.gloss_en: chased in order to catch
cards.ex_en: The dog pursued the cat down the street.
cards.ex_cn: 那只狗沿街追赶那只猫。

cards.gloss_en: an old long-barrelled gun fired from the shoulder
cards.ex_en: The soldier loaded his musket slowly.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵慢慢给他的滑膛枪装弹。

cards.gloss_en: die, especially in a sudden or violent way
cards.ex_en: Many plants perish in the cold winter.
cards.ex_cn: 许多植物在寒冬中死去。

cards.gloss_en: signalled to someone with a hand gesture
cards.ex_en: The teacher beckoned me to come closer.
cards.ex_cn: 老师招手示意我走近些。

cards.gloss_en: likely to happen or be true
cards.ex_en: Rain is probable this afternoon.
cards.ex_cn: 今天下午很可能下雨。

cards.gloss_en: cloth made from the flax plant
cards.ex_en: The shirt was made of soft linen.
cards.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是用柔软的亚麻布做的。

cards.gloss_en: streams of water moving in one direction
cards.ex_en: Strong currents pulled the boat away.
cards.ex_cn: 湍急的水流把船冲走了。

cards.gloss_en: a small group of trees
cards.ex_en: We had a picnic in the orange grove.
cards.ex_cn: 我们在橘子林里野餐。

cards.gloss_en: a number of shots fired at the same time
cards.ex_en: The soldiers fired a volley into the air.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵们朝天齐射了一轮。

cards.gloss_en: an illness or disorder of the body
cards.ex_en: The old dog suffered from a strange distemper.
cards.ex_cn: 那只老狗患了一种奇怪的疾病。

cards.gloss_en: free time away from work
cards.ex_en: He reads books in his leisure time.
cards.ex_cn: 他在闲暇时间读书。

cards.gloss_en: an unfortunate or pitiable person
cards.ex_en: The poor wretch had no food or home.
cards.ex_cn: 那个可怜人无食无家。

cards.gloss_en: careful thought about something
cards.ex_en: After much consideration, she said yes.
cards.ex_cn: 经过再三考虑,她答应了。

cards.gloss_en: wise and showing good judgment
cards.ex_en: It is sensible to wear a coat in winter.
cards.ex_cn: 冬天穿外套是明智的。

cards.gloss_en: a person who makes things from wood
cards.ex_en: The carpenter made a wooden table.
cards.ex_cn: 木匠做了一张木桌。

cards.gloss_en: very unpleasant or nasty
cards.ex_en: The medicine had a horrid taste.
cards.ex_cn: 这药有股可怕的味道。

cards.gloss_en: ships or large boats
cards.ex_en: Many vessels sailed into the busy port.
cards.ex_cn: 许多船只驶入繁忙的港口。

cards.gloss_en: a small drink of strong alcohol
cards.ex_en: The old man drank a dram of whisky.
cards.ex_cn: 老人喝了一小杯威士忌。

cards.gloss_cn: 补救办法、疗法;(no remedy but to)别无办法只能
cards.gloss_en: a cure or fix; (no remedy but to) no choice but to
cards.ex_en: Honey is a good remedy for a sore throat.
cards.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是治嗓子痛的好方法。

cards.gloss_en: matters or business to be dealt with
cards.ex_en: He manages the company's affairs carefully.
cards.ex_cn: 他谨慎地打理公司的事务。

cards.gloss_en: gladly, or having no choice but to
cards.ex_en: The tired travellers would fain rest a while.
cards.ex_cn: 疲惫的旅人只得歇息一会儿。

cards.gloss_en: upright stakes fixed in the ground
cards.ex_en: They set wooden posts along the fence.
cards.ex_cn: 他们沿着篱笆立起木柱。

cards.gloss_en: a daily record of events
cards.ex_en: She writes in her journal every night.
cards.ex_cn: 她每晚都在日记里写点东西。

cards.gloss_en: killed by hanging from a rope
cards.ex_en: In the past, thieves were sometimes hanged.
cards.ex_cn: 从前,小偷有时会被处以绞刑。

cards.gloss_en: units for measuring grain
cards.ex_en: The farmer sold ten bushels of corn.
cards.ex_cn: 农夫卖了十蒲式耳玉米。

cards.gloss_en: able to be thought of or imagined
cards.ex_en: They tried every method imaginable.
cards.ex_cn: 他们试遍了所有能想到的办法。

cards.gloss_en: covered in blood; violent
cards.ex_en: The two armies fought a bloody battle.
cards.ex_cn: 两军打了一场血腥的战斗。

cards.gloss_en: guns that shoot bullets
cards.ex_en: The police keep firearms locked away.
cards.ex_cn: 警察把枪械锁起来保管。

cards.gloss_en: firm decisions to do something
cards.ex_en: He made several resolutions for the new year.
cards.ex_cn: 他为新年立下了几个决心。

cards.gloss_en: evil or morally bad behaviour
cards.ex_en: The story warns us against wickedness.
cards.ex_cn: 这个故事告诫我们远离邪恶。

cards.gloss_en: admit something you did wrong
cards.ex_en: He decided to confess his mistake.
cards.ex_cn: 他决定坦白自己的错误。

cards.gloss_en: thick strong ropes or chains
cards.ex_en: Thick cables held the ship to the dock.
cards.ex_cn: 粗缆绳把船系在码头上。

cards.gloss_en: the officer in charge of a ship's crew and gear
cards.ex_en: The boatswain called the sailors on deck.
cards.ex_cn: 水手长把水手们叫到甲板上。

cards.gloss_en: daring to go somewhere risky
cards.ex_en: They kept venturing deeper into the cave.
cards.ex_cn: 他们不断冒险深入洞穴。

cards.gloss_en: based on clear thinking and reason
cards.ex_en: Try to make a rational decision.
cards.ex_cn: 试着做出理性的决定。

cards.gloss_en: a curved part of a coastline
cards.ex_en: The little boat sailed into the quiet bay.
cards.ex_cn: 小船驶进了平静的海湾。

cards.gloss_en: a piece of land jutting into the sea
cards.ex_en: The lighthouse stands on a rocky cape.
cards.ex_cn: 灯塔矗立在多岩石的海角上。

cards.gloss_en: chase, or try hard to achieve
cards.ex_en: The police will pursue the runaway car.
cards.ex_cn: 警察会追赶那辆逃跑的车。

suspect.ctx: I had no remedy but to go on: I had got into an employment quite remote to my genius
suspect.issue: 书中是固定说法 no remedy but to = 别无办法/别无选择,只能继续;现释义"补救办法、疗法"里"疗法"这一义完全不搭,"补救办法"也偏窄,回读为"我别无补救办法只能继续"略生硬
suspect.suggest: 增补"(常用于 no remedy but)办法、出路;别无选择"一义

suspect.ctx: the storm was so violent that I saw, what is not often seen, the master, the boatswain, and some others more sensible than the rest
suspect.issue: 此处 Defoe 旧义偏向"更清醒察觉到危险的/意识到处境的"(见船将沉而祈祷),不单是"明智";"more sensible than the rest"回读为"比其余人更有察觉"更贴,现释义只给引申的"明智"
suspect.suggest: 增补"(旧)察觉到的、意识到(危险/处境)的"一义
